items.prompt: Why is changing request field names/types only one part of a safe API evolution review?
items.modelAnswer: Defaults/units/meaning/error/retry and authorization/resource behavior can break clients even if wire types parse. Need source/wire/semantic direction-specific old/new tests, version/migration and response/error contracts. Shape validation does not grant authority or prove business commit/security.
